summary: Game session initialization entry point. Sets the game-entered flag at this+0x0 to 1, logs an 'entered game enter' debug line when StringSplitLoop parsing of aDDevF119992002_11 succeeds, then sequentially initializes subsystems — OS manager (OSMan_Enter), game files (GameFileLoader), video (VidMan_Enter), special FX, dynamics, player files, audio configs, sound, input, on-screen display and the module hook sub_463E20. Builds an audio config path from the season directory (dword_5EC3D8, fallback byte_5EA438) plus dword_7D0434 and decodes it, retrying with the aF12002Gdb track DB name on failure; then loads all .rcd and .pit files found via DirectoryEntryIterator. Returns 1 on any subsystem init failure, 0 on success.

local_names.this: game session object; this+0x0 carries the game-entered flag
local_names.v3/v4/v5/v7: season directory path (dword_5EC3D8 or fallback byte_5EA438)

operations.description: Game-entered flag at this+0x0 is set to 1 on entry
When StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_11, 360) succeeds, DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredGameEnt) logs the 'Entered game enter' message
OSMan_Enter(&unk_7CE2A4) initializes the OS manager; a non-zero result returns 1 immediately
GameFileLoader(this) loads game files; a non-zero result returns 1 immediately
VidMan_Enter(&unk_8AFE18) initializes video; a non-zero result returns 1 immediately
Subsystem enters without failure checks: SpecialFX_Enter(&dword_8ACEA0), DynMan_Enter(), PlayerFile_Enter(&byte_7CE498)
Audio path assembly: season directory from dword_5EC3D8 (fallback byte_5EA438 when null) is concatenated with dword_7D0434 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v9, "%s%s", dir, dword_7D0434)
AudioFileLoadDecode(v9, 0) decodes the audio config; on failure StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(aF12002Gdb) rebuilds the path and the decode retries

.rcd load pass: sub_565F80(aRcd, 1, dir, 0) seeds the directory scan, then DirectoryEntryIterator(&unk_8AD3B0) yields each entry which is decoded with AudioFileLoadDecode(i, 0) and advanced via LinkedListNodePeek(&unk_8AD3B0)

.pit load pass: sub_565F80(aPit, 1, dir, 0) seeds the directory scan, then the same DirectoryEntryIterator(&unk_8AD3B0) / AudioFileLoadDecode(i, 0) / LinkedListNodePeek(&unk_8AD3B0) loop decodes every entry
Sound_Enter(&byte_8AC494) initializes sound; a non-zero result returns 1 immediately
HWInput_Enter(&ppvOut) initializes hardware input; a non-zero result returns 1 immediately
Final module enters: EmptyStub_0170(&unk_7CE24D), EmptyStub_0170(&dword_8AB6E4), OnScreen_Enter(&dword_7CE048), EmptyStub_0170(&dword_8ACEE0), sub_463E20(&dword_7CD25C)
Returns 0 on full success; each checked subsystem enter (OSMan, game files, video, sound, input) returns 1 on its failure
